title: Rotamac
description: rotamac.ca Rotamac Inc. is a privately held industrial equipment distributor founded in November 2019 and based in Rosemère/Montreal, Quebec, Canada (283 rue de Normandie, Rosemère, QC J7A 1T4). It is a micro company of 1–10 employees, essentially built around owner-founder Joey Desrosiers (HEC Montréal, 20+ years in compressed air and rotating equipment). Revenue is not publicly disclosed (small private company), but its e-commerce arm canadacompressorparts.com carries ~43,675 SKUs of non-OEM compressor parts (Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, CompAir compatible) shipping across Canada. Core business: sales representation and distribution of pumps, air/gas compressors, vacuum pumps and nitrogen/oxygen generators, focused on lowering Total Cost of Ownership
